state.user_prompt: Summarize the following tweets about Netflix in 5 sentences. Just tell me what normal people think about Netflix; most of these tweets say the same thing anyway, and the odd ones out don’t really represent anyone. Keep it simple.
state.summary: Some users express excitement about renewing their Netflix subscriptions to watch specific movies or shows like South Park and The Walking Dead. Several tweets describe relaxing at home alone, often in bed or wearing sweats, while binge-watching content on the platform. A few individuals complain about technical issues such as the app not loading or note that certain titles are missing from the library. Others mention sharing passwords with friends or family members to access the service together. Some users also voice frustration regarding high costs, poor recommendations, or having to disconnect devices due to relationship conflicts.

query.query: NetflixSubscription and hasContent some (South Park or TheWalkingDead)
NetflixSubscription and sharesPassword with some Person
